01

Equipment System

Weapons, accessories, and passive gear sources

Equipment in Archlight is spread across weapon families, accessories, relics, quest rewards, crafted items, and late-game weapon paths.

Use this page to compare where each item comes from, how far it can be upgraded, and which progression path it belongs to.

01
Weapon familiesStarter, quest, Ashen, Mastercrafted, Forgemaster, and Olympus weapon lines are grouped by family.
02
Tier and capTier, upgrade cap, attack power, and source show how each weapon fits into progression.
03
Accessories and relicsAmulets, rings, and relics add passive bonuses from quests, crafting, traders, events, and roulette sources.
04
Olympus pathOlympus weapons are the late-game soulbound path built on Forgemaster equipment progression.

Backpack and Equipment Search

The backpack search filters items by name and jumps the view directly to the selected item. The equipment interface also has a global search button that searches through all equipped backpacks instead of only the opened backpack.

Boss Equipment Route

Boss equipment sets are obtained through the raid point path and are handled through Stronghold NPCs. Alvaro handles raid point equipment, while Dominik handles combining and exchanging equipment.

Progression Cannot Be Skipped

Boss, Olympus, and Celestial items must still be combined with the previous progression equipment before they can be equipped. The path remains sequential even when exchange options are available.

02

Family selector with equipment reference tables

03

Accessories and Relics

Amulets, rings, and backpack relics

Accessories and relics are passive equipment layers. Amulets and rings focus on stat bonuses, while relics are carried in the backpack and provide restoration, experience, essence, loot, or gem-related effects.

◈

Amulets

Purchased and crafted amulets with skill, regeneration, damage, essence find, and quest reward effects.

◌

Rings

Resistance, monster essence, recovery, skill value, and promotion item trader options.

✦

Relics

Backpack relics that boost restoration of elixirs and runes, with several event, quest, and trader sources.

04

Olympus Equipment

Late-game soulbound weapon path
Icon

Olympus weapons are late-game weapons that are about 15% stronger than Forgemaster weapons.

The weapon chance increases with the amount of attempts, so the path is not based only on pure RNG.

Olympus weapons must be used with their respective Forgemaster weapon, which means the earlier weapon path cannot be skipped.

A character can only drop one soulbound Olympus weapon for their vocation. If the character changes vocation, the matching weapon has to be farmed separately.

Olympus and Forgemaster weapons can be split with a Soul Splitter from the Token Exchanger NPC.

Olympus weapon ingredients only become usable or droppable after the related quest condition is active.

Boss Equipment Sets

Archangel, Bialzhar, Sarandiel, Vilespine, and Lichlord Nefraxis equipment are part of the current boss-equipment layer. These items are obtained from Alvaro in exchange for Raid Points. Their base tier, cap level, PvP damage reduction, attack power, and Monster Essence values match the Kraken and Forgemaster equipment layer, while each set has its own set bonus.

Combining and Exchanging Equipment

Combine through DominikStronghold NPC

Dominik handles combining and exchanging equipment. Equipment exchanges use Equipment Exchange Tokens, while weapon exchanges still use Weapon Exchange Tokens.

LAT Exchange Token2 per LAT

Each Living Archlight Token buys 2 Equipment Exchange Tokens for boss equipment exchange support.

Hades Weapon Activation100% vocation drop

After slaying Hades, vocation weapons drop in deactivated form. Take them to Dominik and pay the required cost to activate them.
